response.query: What visitor carrying-capacity thresholds and demand-management interventions will be tied to biodiversity triggers (camera, transect, NDVI), and how will visitor monitoring be operationalized and reported?
response.answer: Visitor carrying-capacity thresholds are set to trigger demand-management interventions when biodiversity metrics like camera counts, transect surveys, or NDVI readings indicate stress. Visitor monitoring is operationalized through real-time tracking and reported via integrated data platforms.
